purpose: Cycle 22 L2: judge the documented MAP-Elites gate's second clause — 'no single lineage > 40% of occupied cells' (deep-research.md:205) — which has never been measured.

metrics.repertoire_divergence_note: the documented clause pairs with a 576-cell repertoire; this archive's proven geometry is 512 (8x8x8 octiles, DR 0029/E1) — the same population every coverage judgement has used. The share is a fraction of OCCUPIED cells and so is well-defined under either, but the two are named separately rather than silently equated.

closed_states: the documented lineage-dominance clause is measured, not merely cited
the founder rule is derived from the engine's own recorded ancestry and lives in one pinned place
the 576-vs-512 repertoire divergence is declared in the artifact rather than silently substituted
blocked_states: the clause judges a SINGLE lineage; concentration across several founder lines is reported as an observation (founders_holding_half_the_archive) and is NOT part of the documented bar
one seed, one parameter set — E4's ten-seed protocol is what any distributional claim would need
a founder line is not the same object as an E5 recurrent morphological family: one is ancestry, the other is descriptor similarity. The two are not compared here

decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 22 L2), quoting deep-research.md:205 — "no single lineage > 40% of occupied cells". A lineage is a founder line (lineage.ancestor_ids[0], else the grid itself); pass if max_founder_share <= 0.40, refuse otherwise. Exactly 40% is not a violation, per the documented wording.
